title: Loading the FloorPlan DWG via libredwg-web + DWGLoader
description: Loads `models/FloorPlan/dwg/model.dwg` end-to-end via `DWGLoader` — the SDK's adapter-injected DWG pipeline. DWG is AutoCAD's proprietary binary format and the SDK doesn't bundle a parser; this example wires `@mlightcad/libredwg-web` (Emscripten port of GNU libredwg, GPL-3.0) from a CDN. The DWGAdapter parses the bytes with libredwg, walks the resulting `DwgDatabase.entities`, maps each entity to the SDK's `DWGDocument` shape (LINE → LINE, LWPOLYLINE → LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE → CIRCLE, ARC → ARC with degree→radian conversion, ELLIPSE / POINT / 3DFACE / INSERT / TEXT / MTEXT pass through with similar normalisation), and hands the resulting document to DWGLoader for SceneModel emission. Layer name becomes the SceneObject id; AutoCAD Color Index maps through DWGLoader's ACI palette. Camera auto-fits to the loaded scene's AABB.
